question: Does the rev30 folded calf reset lie outside the live action envelope, and does a reachable calf reset change immediate contact safety or training-time hard-limit attribution?

single_intervention.name: calf_reset_rad
single_intervention.rationale: Stored PhysX limits predict a scale-0.60 calf target minimum of -2.289163871 rad. -2.28 is a bounded reachable candidate; live limits, reset geometry and contact safety must be checked before any candidate training.

runtime_probe.pose_assignment: stratified prone/supine/left_side/right_side for each action mode
measures: live hard and soft joint limits
unclipped hold action and reachable target error
non-foot contact force normalized by total body weight

training_attribution.instrumentation: pre-reset observation during official PPO execution; preserve step results and termination callables
training_attribution.required_training_safety: numeric-invalid and hard-limit must both remain zero; a diagnostic-complete report never authorizes full300

interpretation_limits: Unreachable reset-hold targets are a calibration inconsistency, not by themselves proof of the hard-limit cause.
EMA can start at the measured reset position outside the eventual action envelope; inspect the transient separately.
Changing calf reset also changes collision geometry and leverage, so improved safety alone would not prove a pure target-range mechanism.
One seed and the observed 4/50 -> 1/50 -> 4/50 sequence do not establish or statistically reject a population-level monotonic relationship.
A short zero-action/hold probe does not demonstrate learned recovery or four-pose qualification.
